papers.title: Solvation Cluster Engineering of Non-Fluorinated Ethers toward High-Energy Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.abstract_en: Abstract Lithium metal batteries (LMBs) can provide high energy density for next-generation energy storage, yet their cycle life remains limited by interfacial incompatibility between electrolyte species and electrodes. Conventional electrolytes based on polar or fluorinated solvents often suffer from sluggish transport kinetics, high cost, and even environmental concerns. Herein, we rationally modulate the polarity and coordination ability of nonfluorinated solvents and report a fluorine-free host–guest synergy electrolyte (HGSE) constructed by tailoring the intermolecular interaction between a long-chain multidentate ether and a monodentate ether solvent. The weak Hδ+–Oδ− intermolecular interaction between these solvents tunes the electrolyte coordination ability and solvation cluster size, leading to a contact ion pair-dominated solvation cluster structure with enhanced ionic conductivity. Meanwhile, the optimized solvation cluster in HGSE promotes anion decomposition while suppressing electrode side reactions, resulting in anion-derived LiF-rich interphases and minimized cathode cracking. More notably, the HGSE electrolyte enables a Li||NCM811 pouch cell to deliver a high energy density of 472.5 Wh kg–1, while a 20 Ah-level anode-free Cu||Ni90 pouch cell with a lean electrolyte (1.5 g Ah–1) achieves a superior energy density of 525 Wh kg–1 with 71.6% capacity retention over 120 cycles. These findings elucidate the role of intermolecular interactions and solvation cluster engineering in high-energy and sustainable LMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 불소가 없는 에테르 용매 간 약한 Hδ+–Oδ− 분자간 상호작용을 이용해 용매화 클러스터 크기와 배위 구조를 조절한 호스트-게스트 시너지 전해질(HGSE)을 제안했다. 이 전해질은 접촉 이온쌍 중심의 용매화 구조로 이온전도도를 높이고, 음이온 유래 LiF 풍부 계면을 형성해 전극 부반응과 캐소드 균열을 억제한다. Li||NCM811 파우치셀에서 472.5 Wh/kg, 20 Ah급 anode-free Cu||Ni90 파우치셀에서는 525 Wh/kg(120사이클, 용량유지율 71.6%)의 에너지밀도를 달성했다.

papers.title: Suppressing Side Reaction via Fluorinated Core–Shell Electrolyte for Durable 4.8 V Li‐Rich Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium‐rich Mn‐based cathode materials with high energy density hold promise for enabling > 500 Wh kg −1 batteries; however, the reactive oxygen species (ROS) generated at high voltages trigger electrolyte decomposition and gas evolution, posing severe interfacial stability challenges and safety risks. Herein, a “side‐reaction inhibition” strategy is proposed by employing a bulky, ROS‐stable diluent to modulate core–shell solvation structures and shield highly reactive solvents, effectively suppressing interfacial side reactions. As a result, a 2.5 Ah pouch cell with an ultrahigh areal capacity of 9.6 mAh cm −2 achieves 502.7 Wh kg −1 and delivers a capacity retention of 89.85% after 50 cycles at 0.1 C, while significantly suppressing gas evolution. This work provides novel insights into electrolyte design for high‐voltage lithium metal batteries through targeted mitigation of reactive oxygen species side effects.
papers.summary_ko: 4.8V급 리튬리치 Mn계 양극에서 발생하는 활성산소종(ROS)으로 인한 전해질 분해와 가스 발생 문제를 해결하기 위해, 부피가 큰 ROS 안정성 희석제로 코어-셸 용매화 구조를 형성하는 '부반응 억제' 전략을 제시했다. 반응성이 높은 용매를 효과적으로 차단해 계면 부반응을 억제했으며, 9.6 mAh/cm² 고면적용량의 2.5 Ah 파우치셀에서 502.7 Wh/kg, 0.1C 50사이클 후 89.85%의 용량유지율과 가스 발생 억제를 달성했다.

papers.title: Self‐Adaptive Gradient Interphase Enables Durable Solid‐State Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Garnet‐type solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) enable safe, high‐energy solid‐state lithium metal batteries (SSLMBs) but suffer from poor interfacial contact and lithium dendrite penetration. Here, we report a machine learning ‐guided interfacial strategy that constructs a self‐adaptive graded interphase from a B 105 M 40 composite interlayer (BiOCl: Mg 3 N 2 = 105:40). The interphase features a lithiophilic LiMg phase at the bottom to ensure intimate Li/LLZTO contact, a porous Li 3 Bi phase to accommodate lithium plating/stripping, and Li 3 N/Li 3 OCl phases that enable fast ionic transport and dendrite suppression. The self‐adaptive gradient interphase maintains stable contact with lithium metal during cycling. As a result, B 105 M 40 ‐Li||LLZTO||B 105 M 40 ‐Li symmetric cells exhibit a high critical current density of 15 mA cm −2 and stable cycling over 5000 h at 14 mA cm −2 . Full cells retain 93.7% capacity after 1000 cycles with LiFePO 4 cathodes at 2.0 C, while those paired with high‐voltage LiNbO 3 @LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 cathodes exhibit cycling for over 1000 cycles at 1.0 C. Moreover, the strategy is applicable to sulfide SSEs, offering a universal interfacial design for long‐life SSLMBs.
papers.summary_ko: 가넷형 고체전해질과 리튬 금속 계면의 접촉 불량 및 덴드라이트 문제를 해결하기 위해, 머신러닝 기반으로 BiOCl과 Mg3N2를 조합한 복합 중간층으로 자기적응형 구배 계면을 설계했다. 하부의 친리튬성 LiMg상이 LLZTO와의 긴밀한 접촉을 보장하고, 다공성 Li3Bi상이 Li 플레이팅/스트리핑을 수용하며, Li3N/Li3OCl상이 빠른 이온전달과 덴드라이트 억제를 돕는다. 대칭셀은 14 mA/cm²에서 5000시간 이상 안정적으로 작동했고(임계전류밀도 15 mA/cm²), LiFePO4 및 고전압 NCM811 완전셀에서도 1000사이클 이상 우수한 용량유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Mechanically‐Driven Reconstruction of Lithium Metal for Stable All‐Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Dendrite growth at lithium‐metal anode remains a critical bottleneck in sulfide‐based all‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs). Current approaches often rely on alloy anodes that compromise energy density or artificial interlayers, introducing additional processing complexity. Herein, we show that accumulated deformation imposed by repeated folding and rolling mechanically reconstructs commercial Li from surface to bulk, replacing a rough carbonate‐rich surface and mixed texture with a refined oxide‐passivated surface and a strongly Li(200)‐preferred texture. At low and medium folding degrees, surface refinement and renewal of the native passivation layer improve solid‐solid contact and interfacial Li‐ion transport, but remain insufficient to prevent short circuiting, whereas high‐degree reconstruction drives texture homogenization, reduces spatial variations in local interfacial response, and synchronizes Li recession and advancement across the rigid Li | solid‐state electrolyte interface. The synchronous interface motion suppresses differential recession and void formation during stripping, while mitigating dendritic Li growth during plating. As a result, Li | LPSCl 1.5 | NMC811 full cells achieve 79.3% capacity retention after 1000 cycles at C/2 rate, support 7.4 mA h cm −2 operation with 0.05% decay per cycle, and cycle stably below 0.5 MPa. These findings establish mechanical reconstruction as a direct materials‐level strategy for stabilizing Li metal in sulfide‐based ASSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 황화물계 전고체전지에서 리튬 금속 음극의 덴드라이트 성장을 억제하기 위해, 반복적인 접기·압연을 통한 기계적 변형으로 상용 리튬 금속을 표면부터 벌크까지 재구성하는 방법을 제시했다. 이를 통해 탄산염이 풍부한 거친 표면을 산화물 패시베이션층과 Li(200) 선호 배향 조직으로 대체했으며, 고강도 재구성은 계면 반응의 공간적 변동을 줄여 스트리핑/플레이팅 시 리튬의 탈리·성장을 동기화해 덴드라이트 형성을 억제한다. Li|LPSCl1.5|NMC811 완전셀은 C/2에서 1000사이클 후 79.3%의 용량유지율과 사이클당 0.05%의 낮은 용량감소율을 보였다.

papers.title: Dynamic Reconstruction of Ion Transport Pathways by a Shape Memory Separator for Safer Lithium Metal Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Thermal safety is a key challenge for high‐energy lithium metal batteries. Conventional separators deform under overheating while sustaining ion transport, accelerating thermal runaway. Herein, we report an aramid‐supported shape memory separator that converts temperature rise into reconstruction of ion transport pathways. A covalently crosslinked PETMP‐TMPTA‐IBOA network is photopolymerized within a porous aramid scaffold. At normal operating temperatures, the interconnected pore structure affords an ionic conductivity of 0.29 mS cm −1 and enables stable Li plating/stripping for over 3000 h. At 140°C, the shape memory network undergoes thermomechanical rearrangement, constricting the percolating pores and increasing the ionic resistance by one order of magnitude. Meanwhile, the aramid scaffold preserves dimensional integrity up to 175°C and maintains electrode isolation after ionic shutdown. The separator is compatible with high‐energy NCM811 and Li‐rich Mn‐based oxide cathodes. In particular, a Li‐rich cathode with high mass loading of 16 mg cm −2 cycles stably for 100 cycles at 0.5 C, delivers nearly 250 mAh g −1 at 60°C, and remains operable up to 125°C. This work establishes thermomechanical reconstruction of ion transport pathways as a general design principle for intrinsically self‐protective lithium metal batteries that reconcile high energy operation with autonomous overheating protection.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬 금속 전지의 열 안전성을 높이기 위해, 온도 상승을 이온 전달 경로의 구조 변화로 전환하는 아라미드 지지 형상기억 분리막을 개발했다. 아라미드 다공성 지지체 내에 가교 고분자 네트워크를 광중합하여, 정상 작동 온도에서는 0.29 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 3000시간 이상의 안정적인 Li 플레이팅/스트리핑을 제공하고, 140°C에서는 형상기억 네트워크의 열기계적 재배열로 기공이 수축되어 이온저항이 한 자릿수 증가한다. 아라미드 골격은 175°C까지 치수 안정성을 유지하며 전극 간 절연을 보존하고, NCM811 및 리튬리치 Mn계 고용량 캐소드와도 호환되어 125°C까지 작동 가능함을 보였다.
